column3: “This report” supplies the object of hearing.
“Palace administrator” specifies being over the house; “leading priests” renders elders of the priests.
“So that” makes explicit a purpose where the clauses are joined by “and.”
The translation repeats “the gods of” before the list of destroyed nations.
The repeated kings and the city of Sepharvaim are compressed into a list of kings.
“Letter” replaces the initial plural writings, which are subsequently referred to in the singular.
“Are God” replaces the final statement that You alone are the LORD.
“In pride” specifies lifting the eyes high.
“Tallest” describes the height of the cedars; “densest of its forests” renders the forest of its fruitful land.
“Wells” and “foreign” are supplied; the streams are identified as Egypt’s canals.
“Devoid of power” renders shortness of hand; the last field image is rendered as vegetation scorched before growing.
“O Hezekiah” identifies the person addressed; the commands in the third-year clause are rendered as future statements.
